rounds.text: The valuation of ARC Finance Ltd is fundamentally disconnected from its current earnings reality, highlighted by an exorbitant trailing P/E of 56.2x that nearly doubles the sector benchmark of 26.2x [E1, E6]. This premium pricing is entirely unsupported by recent performance, as demonstrated by a sharp contraction in trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth of -32% [E21]. Furthermore, shareholders receive zero income protection during this downturn, with the dividend yield sitting flat at 0.00% [E4]. The market's lack of confidence is further evidenced by the equity languishing near the bottom of its yearly range at just 11% of the way up its 52-week band [E5]. Conceded: [E2, E7, E8, E18, E19, E20].

blind_spot_facts.fact: FUNDAMENTALS-LED — Recently, profit growth exceeds 1-year price growth by 13%, the company is starting to outperform expectations.
